title_sq: Shitet - Zyre 60 m2 tek rruga Elbasanit
description_sq:
Ofrohet zyre per shitje ne rrugen e Elbasanit, prane Liceut Artistik.
Zyra eshte pjese e nje pallat te ri (ndodhur buze Rr. Elbasanit), ku katet e para i ka ambiente biznesi,
me hyrje te dedikuar.
Pozicionohet ne kat te 2-te
Siperfaqe totale 60 m2, neto 50 m2.
Zyra ka investim dhe mobilim cilesor.
Shitet e mobiluar.
title_en: For sale - Office 60 m2 on Elbasanit street
description_en: An office is offered for sale on Elbasani Street, near the Artistic High School. The office is part of a new building (located on the edge of Elbasan St.), where the first floors have business premises, with a dedicated entrance. Positioned on the 2nd floor, total area 60 m2, net 50 m2. The office has investment and quality furniture. For sale furnished.
